Episode 62: Magic Tab
Keshav gets his hands on a magic tab that reveals what a person is up to at a given point of time. Keshav uses this tab to see what Prema is doing at night. The tab reveals that two people try to kidnap Prema. How will Keshav avert this disaster? Watch this episode to find out.
